canonical.topic: eduNest intro: Student, Parent, and Teacher perspectives

stages.title: Student
stages.description: eduNest turns every problem into step-by-step thinking, not just an answer. See why each step works and how formulas connect to intuition; get AI-guided questions, hints, and feedback when stuck; build a clearer learning path as the system learns your weak spots.
stages.key_concept: Vertex form of parabola y=a(x-h)²+k: vertex and opening
stages.interactivity_hint: Drag a, h, k sliders to see the parabola change

stages.title: Parent
stages.description: See what your child is learning and where they get stuck, with clear data. See which steps they spend time on and which concepts they find hard; AI tutoring is like having a teacher on call; content in multiple languages and grades, create once and use everywhere.
stages.key_concept: Multi-dimensional learning analysis (Understanding, Behavior, Metacognition, Emotion, Mastery)
stages.interactivity_hint: View analysis chart and brief summary

stages.title: Teacher
stages.description: Spend less time on repetitive tasks and more on teaching. Generate interactive slides and practice in seconds, multi-language and multi-grade; AI handles hints, feedback, and Q&A for scalable one-to-one support; learning data feeds back into content and teaching decisions in a closed loop.
stages.key_concept: Pythagorean theorem: relationship between legs and hypotenuse in a right triangle
stages.interactivity_hint: Adjust AC and BC sliders to update the problem and answer; click "Another problem" for a new triple

learning_objectives: Understand how a, h, k in y=a(x-h)²+k affect the parabola graph
Interpret the multi-dimensional learning analysis chart and learning health index
Apply the Pythagorean theorem in fill-in-the-blank for right triangles

concept_map.description: Vertex at (h,k); a controls opening direction and width
Composite of five dimensions: Understanding, Behavior, Metacognition, Emotion, Mastery
In a right triangle, the sum of squares of the legs equals the square of the hypotenuse

interactions_summary.action: Click Student, Parent, or Teacher tab
interactions_summary.result: Switch to the corresponding panel content
Parabola updates in real time; vertex and opening change
Show five-dimension bar chart and brief summary
AC, BC, and AB values in the problem update automatically
